# `search` command

Search the configured package indexes (and the indexes they follow).

```bash
fobis search --help
```

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

Arguments: `TERM`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--module` | TEXT |  | Find the packages providing this module. |
| `--config` | TEXT |  | User configuration file (default ~/.config/fobis/config.ini). |
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT | `fobos` | Project fobos whose [indexes] are searched first. |
| `--depth` | INTEGER | `2` | How far 'follows' is walked (0: configured indexes only). |
| `--refresh` |  |  | Fetch the indexes again instead of using the cache. |
| `--json` |  |  | Machine-readable output. |

<!-- cli:end -->
